mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profit margins through higher wage growth and reduced labor costs, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 3.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) combined with a stable or declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% in 3 months) indicates a delayed monetary policy response, which leads to positive equity returns as the market prices in a prolonged period of accommodative policy.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% over 3 months, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market expansion (HOUST above 1400.0 and growing at over 1.0% annually), increased residential construction activity signals strong consumer confidence and rising disposable income, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1400.0 and HOUST growth > 1.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 1400.0 and HOUST growth > 1.0% over 3 months, the S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in industrial production growth above 0.5% annually indicates robust supply chain activity and strong manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% annually, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months) signals an overheating labor market that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% over 3 months, the S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in retail sales above 700,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 700,000 million dollars, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation above 3.5% annually signals a need for monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
